dish.title: Balkan Cevapi with Ajvar, Raw Onion, and Warm Pita
dish.description: Small garlicky sausages of ground beef and lamb seasoned with paprika, seared until browned, tucked into warm pita with ajvar red pepper relish, chopped raw onion, and a cucumber, tomato, and parsley salad.

recipe_version.title: Balkan Cevapi with Ajvar, Raw Onion, and Warm Pita
recipe_version.description: Small garlicky sausages of ground beef and lamb seasoned with paprika, seared until browned, tucked into warm pita with ajvar red pepper relish, chopped raw onion, and a cucumber, tomato, and parsley salad.

ingredients.name: pita
ingredients.display_name: pocketless pita breads whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, sugar, and salt

ingredients.name: ajvar
ingredients.display_name: ajvar whose label lists red peppers, eggplant, sunflower oil, vinegar, salt, and sugar

steps.title: Mix and shape
steps.body: In the large bowl, mix the beef, lamb, garlic, baking soda, paprika, 1 1/2 tsp salt, pepper, and 3 tbsp cold water with your hand until sticky and tacky. Shape into 20 fingers about 3 inches long and 1 inch thick and set on the sheet pan.

steps.title: Salad and onion
steps.body: Toss the cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, olive oil, and 1/4 tsp salt in the medium bowl. Finely chop the onion.

steps.title: Sear the cevapi
steps.body: Heat the oil in the cast-iron skillet over medium-high, about 3 minutes. Cook 10 cevapi, turning with tongs, until browned all over and 160 F, about 8 minutes. Repeat (2 batches).

steps.title: Warm the pita
steps.body: Warm each pita in the skillet over medium, about 30 seconds per side, and wrap in the kitchen towel.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Split or fold each pita, spread with ajvar, add 5 cevapi and a spoonful of onion, and serve with the salad.
